title: Albertsons Companies, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Albertsons Companies, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing FY2025 financial results, an opioid settlement framework with approximately $774 million in payments over nine years, and a 13% increase in the quarterly cash dividend from $0.15 to $0.17 per share.
key_points: Company announced financial results for 13 and 53 weeks ended February 28, 2026
Opioid Settlement Framework: approximately $774 million over nine years (one-third within first two years)
Estimated after-tax net present value of settlement: approximately $482 million
First payment expected April 30, 2026 into escrow until final settlement
Board increased quarterly cash dividend 13% from $0.15 to $0.17 per share
Next dividend payment of $0.17 per share scheduled for May 8, 2026 to stockholders of record April 24, 2026
